verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a payments API platform with SDKs and a dashboard, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry opt-out, SDK analytics toggle, or usage-tracking control. The fraud Profiler collects end-user browsing traits rather than offering an opt-out, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
